{"predictors": [
  {"name": "Employee Satisfaction Index", "construction": "Derived from public surveys and social media sentiment analysis about the company as a place to work, normalized on a -1 to 1 scale.", "rationale": "Happier employees may be more productive, leading to better company performance.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
  {"name": "CEO Tenure", "construction": "The number of years the current CEO has been in the position.", "rationale": "Longer-tenured CEOs may indicate stable leadership and vice versa.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Index of Market Expectation Versus Analyst Expectation", "construction": "The difference between market consensus (as represented by the current stock price) and analyst consensus on future earnings, normalized as a ratio.", "rationale": "Significant discrepancies might indicate an under- or over-valued stock.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Tax Rate Volatility", "construction": "Standard deviation of the company's effective tax rate over the past five years.", "rationale": "Greater tax rate volatility may indicate financial instability or aggressive tax strategies.", "higher_returns_for": "Low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Social Responsibility Index", "construction": "A measure of the company's impact on society (e.g., environmental record, community involvement), derived from public data and normalized on a -1 to 1 scale.", "rationale": "Companies with higher social responsibility scores may be more attractive to investors, boosting demand for their shares.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Product Recalls", "construction": "Number of product recalls conducted by the company over the past three years.", "rationale": "Frequent recalls may indicate poor quality control, affecting the company's reputation and sales.", "higher_returns_for": "Low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "R&D Expenditure Ratio", "construction": "Ratio of Research & Development expenditure to total revenue.", "rationale": "Higher R&D investments may lead to innovative products and services, improving future profitability.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Debt Maturity Structure", "construction": "Weighted average maturity of the company's debt.", "rationale": "Longer debt maturities may indicate a lower risk of default.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Percentage of Independent Directors", "construction": "Ratio of independent directors to the total number of directors on the board.", "rationale": "A higher percentage of independent directors may indicate better corporate governance.", "higher_returns_for": "High values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Customer Concentration", "construction": "Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) of customer concentration, calculated from the company's disclosed major customers.", "rationale": "Greater customer concentration may indicate higher business risk.", "higher_returns_for": "Low values of the measure"}
]}
